voice: Retain her affected emphasis, condescension, and social performance without phonetic upper-class spelling.

entries.text: Why, isn't that one of those DARLING little Egyptian trinkets?
Oh, could that be some of that CUTE little Egyptian writing? How CHARMING!
New York is simply CHARMING, Miss Bow. It has so much culture...for an American city.
You ARE an odd girl, Miss Bow. But so CHARMING.
It is CHARMING, dear girl, but it is not MINE.
That is odd. Mr. Dorian said you met Dr. Carrington in a taxi when he arrived by steamship from England.
I have not had the pleasure of meeting him, but he sounds simply CHARMING. I imagine a man who runs a newspaper must be quite wealthy, mmmm?
Well, so what if I did? I mean, yes, I met him that night. Our families are old allies from the Wars of the Roses. I felt obliged to greet him upon his arrival. Noblesse oblige, you understand.
Well, isn't that CHARMING! A little reporter!
Oh, he is a DARLING little man. Simply DARLING.
What a LOVELY boy. He has such CHARMING manners, and he is SO handsome, mmmmm?
